snippet.title: INDIE GAME LAUNCH TRAILER: Ungrateful Birds: No Good Deed & Ungrateful Birds: Call of the Desert
snippet.description:
What if you had to save some birds? What if those birds were terribly ungrateful?

Announcing the release of UNGRATEFUL BIRDS: NO GOOD DEED and UNGRATEFUL BIRDS: CALL OF THE DESERT. Together, they have over 50 challenging stages of frantic, bird-rescuing slapstick, for up to two players (local co-op). Available now for Windows!

Find out more and get them both at @itchiogames: https://jdmgames.itch.io/ungrateful-birds-no-good-deed

Trailer features music from Snabisch (http://makeagame.bandcamp.com/). See itch.io website for full list of credits of sounds used in the game. 

Games © 2023, John D. Moore/Whatnot Studios
